topics.name: Four Centres
topics.description: Study the properties of circumcentre, incentre, centroid, and orthocentre
topics.descriptionZh: 研究外心、內心、重心和垂心的性質

categories.description: Test your understanding of core concepts
categories.descriptionZh: 測試您對核心概念的理解

questions.stem: Define the circumcentre of a triangle.
questions.stemZh: 定義三角形的外心。

options.A: The centre of the inscribed circle
options.B: The centre of the circumscribed circle
options.C: The average of the three vertices

questions.hint: Think about which circle passes through all three vertices of a triangle.
questions.hintZh: 想想哪個圓經過三角形的三個頂點。
questions.solution: The circumcentre is the centre of the circumscribed circle that passes through all three vertices of the triangle.
questions.solutionZh: 外心是經過三角形三個頂點的外接圓的圓心。

questions.stem: What is the incentre of a triangle?
questions.stemZh: 什麼是三角形的內心？

options.B: The point where angle bisectors meet
options.C: The point where perpendicular bisectors meet

questions.hint: The incentre is related to the inscribed circle.
questions.hintZh: 內心與內切圓有關。
questions.solution: The incentre is the intersection point of the three angle bisectors of a triangle.
questions.solutionZh: 內心是三角形三條角平分線的交點。

questions.stem: Which lines meet at the centroid?
questions.stemZh: 哪三條線相交於重心？
questions.hint: A median joins a vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.
questions.hintZh: 中線連接頂點與對邊中點。
questions.solution: The three medians meet at the centroid.

questions.stem: Which lines meet at the orthocentre?
questions.stemZh: 哪三條線相交於垂心？
questions.hint: Each line is perpendicular to the opposite side.
questions.hintZh: 每條線均垂直於對邊。
questions.solution: The orthocentre is the intersection of the three altitudes.
questions.solutionZh: 垂心是三條高線的交點。

questions.stem: The incentre is equidistant from which objects?
questions.stemZh: 內心到以下哪些對象的距離相等？
questions.hint: The incircle touches all three sides.
questions.hintZh: 內切圓與三條邊相切。
questions.solution: The perpendicular distances from the incentre to the three sides are all equal to the inradius.
questions.solutionZh: 內心到三條邊的垂直距離均等於內切圓半徑。

questions.stem: Given triangle ABC with A(0,0), B(4,0), C(2,3). Find the coordinates of the circumcentre.
questions.stemZh: 已知三角形ABC，其中A(0,0), B(4,0), C(2,3)。求外心的坐標。
questions.hint: The circumcentre is equidistant from all three vertices.
questions.hintZh: 外心到三個頂點的距離相等。
questions.solution: The perpendicular bisector of AB is x = 2. Put O = (2, y). Since OA² = OC², 4 + y² = (3 − y)², giving 6y = 5. Hence O = (2, 5/6).
questions.solutionZh: AB 的垂直平分線為 x = 2。設 O = (2, y)，由 OA² = OC²，得 4 + y² = (3 − y)²，所以 6y = 5，外心為 (2, 5/6)。

questions.stem: A triangle has vertices (0, 0), (6, 0), (0, 9). Find its centroid.
questions.hint: Average the three x-coordinates and then the three y-coordinates.
questions.hintZh: 分別求三個 x 坐標及三個 y 坐標的平均值。

questions.stem: A(0, 0), B(8, 0), C(2, 6) form a triangle. Find its orthocentre.
questions.stemZh: 三角形的頂點為 A(0, 0)、B(8, 0)、C(2, 6)。求垂心坐標。
questions.hint: The altitude from C is vertical. Find the slope of BC.
questions.hintZh: 從 C 出發的高線是垂直線。先求 BC 的斜率。
questions.solution: AB is horizontal, so the altitude from C is x = 2. The slope of BC is −1, so the altitude from A is y = x. They meet at (2, 2).
questions.solutionZh: AB 是水平線，從 C 出發的高線為 x = 2。BC 的斜率為 −1，故從 A 出發的高線為 y = x。交點為 (2, 2)。

questions.stem: A triangle has vertices (1,2), (7,2), (4,8). Find the y-coordinate of its centroid.
questions.stemZh: 三角形頂點為 (1,2)、(7,2)、(4,8)。求重心的 y 坐標。
questions.solution: The centroid has y-coordinate (2+2+8)/3 = 4.
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。

questions.stem: A triangle has vertices A(0,0), B(4,0), C(2,3). Find the y-coordinate of its circumcentre. A fraction is accepted.
questions.stemZh: 三角形頂點為 A(0,0)、B(4,0)、C(2,3)。求外心的 y 坐標，可輸入分數。
questions.solution: The circumcentre is (2,y). Equal distances give 4+y²=(3−y)². Hence 6y=5, so y=5/6.
questions.solutionZh: 外心為 (2,y)。由等距性質得 4+y²=(3−y)²，所以 6y=5，y=5/6。
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。

questions.stem: A(0,0), B(8,0), C(2,6) form a triangle. (a) Find the altitude from C. (b) Find the altitude from A. (c) Find the orthocentre.
questions.stemZh: 三角形頂點為 A(0,0)、B(8,0)、C(2,6)。(a) 求從 C 出發的高線方程；(b) 求從 A 出發的高線方程；(c) 求垂心。
questions.solution:
(a) AB is horizontal, so the altitude from C is x=2.
(b) The slope of BC is −1. The perpendicular slope is 1, so the altitude from A is y=x.
(c) The intersection is (2,2).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) AB 水平，故高線為 x=2。
(b) BC 斜率為 −1，高線斜率為 1，通過 A，所以 y=x。
(c) 兩線相交於 (2,2)。
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。
rubric: 高線 x=2。
用垂直斜率關係求得 y=x。
正確求得垂心 (2,2)。

questions.stem: Prove, using coordinates, that the midpoint of the hypotenuse of a right triangle is equidistant from all three vertices.
questions.stemZh: 用坐標法證明直角三角形斜邊的中點到三個頂點等距。
questions.solution: Place the vertices at A(0,0), B(2a,0), C(0,2b), where a,b>0. The midpoint of BC is M(a,b). MA²=a²+b², MB²=(2a−a)²+b²=a²+b², MC²=a²+(2b−b)²=a²+b². Hence MA=MB=MC.
questions.solutionZh: 設 A(0,0)、B(2a,0)、C(0,2b)，a,b>0。斜邊 BC 的中點為 M(a,b)。MA²=MB²=MC²=a²+b²，所以 MA=MB=MC。
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。
rubric: 建立一個一般的直角三角形坐標模型。
求得斜邊中點 M(a,b)。
用距離公式證明三段距離的平方相等。

questions.stem: Which theorem directly explains why the midpoint of the hypotenuse is the circumcentre of a right triangle?
questions.stemZh: 哪個定理可直接解釋為何直角三角形的斜邊中點是外心？

options.A: Use the property of the inscribed angle
options.B: Use the theorem about angles in a semicircle

questions.hint: Think of the hypotenuse as the diameter of a circle.
questions.hintZh: 以斜邊作圓的直徑。
questions.solution: Draw the circle with the hypotenuse as diameter. Its semicircle subtends a right angle, so the right-angle vertex lies on this circle. All three vertices lie on the circle; its centre is the midpoint of the hypotenuse.
questions.solutionZh: 以斜邊為直徑作圓。由半圓內的圓周角為直角，直角頂點在此圓上，故三個頂點共圓；圓心就是斜邊中點。

topics.name: Polynomials
topics.descriptionZh: 因式分解、方程同定理應用

questions.stem: Which expression is a factor of x² − 9?
questions.stemZh: 以下哪個式子是 x² − 9 的因式？
questions.hint: Use the difference of two squares.
questions.hintZh: 留意平方差公式。
questions.solution: x² − 9 = (x − 3)(x + 3), so x − 3 is a factor.
questions.solutionZh: x² − 9 = (x − 3)(x + 3)，所以 x − 3 是其中一個因式。

questions.stem: Factorise 6x² − 9x.
questions.stemZh: 分解因式：6x² − 9x。
questions.hint: Take out the greatest common factor of both terms.
questions.hintZh: 提出兩項的最大公因式。
questions.solution: The greatest common factor is 3x. Hence 6x² − 9x = 3x(2x − 3).

questions.stem: Factorise x² + 5x + 6.
questions.stemZh: 分解因式：x² + 5x + 6。
questions.hint: Find two numbers whose sum is 5 and product is 6.
questions.hintZh: 找出兩個數，使它們的和為 5，積為 6。

questions.stem: Find the remainder when 2x³ − 3x + 4 is divided by x − 2.
questions.stemZh: 求 2x³ − 3x + 4 除以 x − 2 的餘式。
questions.hint: For division by x − a, the remainder is f(a).
questions.hintZh: 除以 x − a 的餘式為 f(a)。
questions.solution: By the remainder theorem, f(2) = 2(2³) − 3(2) + 4 = 14.

questions.stem: x + 1 is a factor of x² + kx − 6. Find k.
questions.stemZh: 已知 x + 1 是 x² + kx − 6 的因式。求 k。
questions.hint: Substitute x = −1 and set the result equal to zero.
questions.hintZh: 代入 x = −1，並令所得結果等於零。
questions.solution: By the factor theorem, f(−1) = 1 − k − 6 = 0. Hence k = −5.

questions.stem: Solve x² − x − 6 = 0.
questions.stemZh: 解方程 x² − x − 6 = 0。
questions.hint: Factorise and use the zero-product property.
questions.hintZh: 先分解因式，再利用零積性質。

questions.stem: x − 2 and x + 1 are factors of x³ + ax² + bx − 6. Find a + b.
questions.stemZh: 已知 x − 2 和 x + 1 均為 x³ + ax² + bx − 6 的因式。求 a + b。
questions.hint: Use f(2) = 0 and f(−1) = 0 to form two equations.
questions.hintZh: 利用 f(2) = 0 及 f(−1) = 0 建立兩條方程。
questions.solution: f(2) = 0 gives 2a + b = −1. f(−1) = 0 gives a − b = 7. Therefore a = 2, b = −5, so a + b = −3.

questions.stem: Find the remainder when x³ − 2x + 5 is divided by x − 2. Enter a number.
questions.stemZh: 求 x³ − 2x + 5 除以 x − 2 的餘式，輸入數值。
questions.solution: By the remainder theorem, f(2) = 8 − 4 + 5 = 9.
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。

questions.stem: x − 3 is a factor of x² + kx − 6. Find k.
questions.stemZh: 已知 x − 3 是 x² + kx − 6 的因式。求 k。
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。

questions.stem: For f(x) = x² − 5x + 6: (a) factorise f(x); (b) solve f(x) = 0. Show your steps.
questions.stemZh: 設 f(x) = x² − 5x + 6：(a) 分解 f(x)；(b) 解 f(x) = 0。寫出步驟。
questions.solution:
(a) Find two numbers with sum −5 and product 6: −2 and −3. f(x) = (x − 2)(x − 3).
(b) (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0, so x = 2 or 3.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) −2 與 −3 的和為 −5，積為 6，所以 f(x) = (x − 2)(x − 3)。
(b) 由零積性質，x = 2 或 3。
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。
rubric: 正確分解成 (x − 2)(x − 3)。
寫出兩個根 x = 2、3，並使用零積性質。

questions.stem: Original DSE-style long question (8 marks). Let f(x) = x³ + ax² + bx − 6. Both x − 1 and x − 2 are factors. (a) Find a and b. (b) Factorise f(x) completely. (c) Solve f(x) = 0.
questions.stemZh: 原創 DSE 風格長題（8 分）。設 f(x) = x³ + ax² + bx − 6，x − 1 和 x − 2 均為其因式。(a) 求 a、b；(b) 完全分解 f(x)；(c) 解 f(x) = 0。
questions.solution:
(a) f(1)=0 gives a+b=5. f(2)=0 gives 2a+b=−1. Subtraction gives a=−6 and b=11.
(b) f(x)=(x−1)(x−2)(x−3).
(c) x=1, 2 or 3.
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。
rubric: 由兩個因式建立兩條正確方程。（2 分）
完全分解成三個一次因式。（2 分）
列出三個根。（2 分）

questions.stem: Prove that the difference between the squares of any two consecutive integers is odd.
questions.stemZh: 證明任意兩個相鄰整數的平方之差必為奇數。
questions.solution: Let the integers be n and n+1, where n is an integer. (n+1)²−n²=2n+1, which is odd. Reversing the order gives −(2n+1), also odd.
questions.solutionZh: 設兩個整數為 n、n+1。(n+1)²−n²=2n+1，是奇數；若倒轉相減，所得負數亦是奇數。
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。
rubric: 以整數 n 表示兩個相鄰整數。
展開並化簡為 2n+1。
指出 2n+1 為奇數，完成結論。

questions.stem: A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. Find its area.
questions.stemZh: 一個長方形長 8 cm、闊 5 cm。求它的面積。
questions.hint: Area of a rectangle = length × width.
questions.hintZh: 長方形面積 = 長 × 闊。
questions.solution: Area = 8 × 5 = 40 cm².

questions.stem: A circle has radius 7 cm. Find its area in terms of π.
questions.stemZh: 一個圓的半徑為 7 cm。以 π 表示它的面積。
questions.hint: Use A = πr².
questions.hintZh: 利用 A = πr²。
questions.solution: A = π × 7² = 49π cm².

questions.stem: A prism has cross-sectional area 12 cm² and length 5 cm. Find its volume.
questions.stemZh: 一個柱體的截面積為 12 cm²，長為 5 cm。求體積。
questions.hint: Multiply the cross-sectional area by the length.
questions.hintZh: 將截面積乘以長度。

questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 8 cm. Find its volume.
questions.stemZh: 一個圓柱的半徑為 3 cm，高為 8 cm。求體積。
questions.hint: Use V = πr²h.
questions.hintZh: 利用 V = πr²h。
questions.solution: V = π × 3² × 8 = 72π cm³.

questions.stem: Find the total surface area of a closed cylinder of radius 3 cm and height 5 cm.
questions.stemZh: 一個密封圓柱的半徑為 3 cm，高為 5 cm。求總表面面積。
questions.hint: Include both circular ends and the curved surface.
questions.hintZh: 包括兩個圓形底面及曲面。
questions.solution: A = 2πr² + 2πrh = 18π + 30π = 48π cm².

questions.stem: Two similar solids have corresponding lengths in the ratio 2 : 3. Find their volume ratio.
questions.stemZh: 兩個相似立體的對應邊長之比為 2 : 3。求體積之比。
questions.hint: Volume scales with the cube of the length scale factor.
questions.hintZh: 體積比等於長度比的三次方。
questions.solution: The volume ratio is 2³ : 3³ = 8 : 27.

questions.stem: A sector has radius 6 cm and angle 120°. Find its area.
questions.stemZh: 一個扇形的半徑為 6 cm，圓心角為 120°。求面積。
questions.hint: A sector occupies θ/360 of the full circle.
questions.hintZh: 扇形佔整個圓的 θ/360。

questions.stem: A rectangle is 12 cm long and 7 cm wide. Find its area in cm². Enter only the number.
questions.stemZh: 長方形長 12 cm、闊 7 cm。求面積（cm²），只需輸入數值。
questions.solution: Area = 12×7 = 84 cm².
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。

questions.stem: A prism has cross-sectional area 18 cm² and length 7 cm. Find its volume in cm³.
questions.stemZh: 柱體截面積為 18 cm²，長 7 cm。求體積（cm³）。
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。

questions.stem: A closed cylinder has radius 4 cm and height 9 cm. (a) Find its volume. (b) Find its total surface area. Give exact answers in terms of π.
questions.stemZh: 一個密封圓柱半徑為 4 cm，高為 9 cm。(a) 求體積；(b) 求總表面面積，以 π 表示答案。
questions.solution:
(a) V=πr²h=π×16×9=144π cm³.
(b) A=2πr²+2πrh=32π+72π=104π cm².
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。
rubric: 體積公式及答案 144π cm³ 正確。
包括兩個底面，總表面面積為 104π cm²。
使用正確平方及立方單位。

questions.stem: Original DSE-style long question (8 marks). Two similar closed cylinders A and B have radii in the ratio 2:3. A has radius 4 cm and height 10 cm. (a) Find the radius and height of B. (b) Find both volumes. (c) Find the ratio of their total surface areas. Explain each scale factor.
questions.stemZh: 原創 DSE 風格長題（8 分）。兩個相似密封圓柱 A、B 的半徑比為 2:3。A 的半徑為 4 cm，高為 10 cm。(a) 求 B 的半徑及高；(b) 求兩者體積；(c) 求總表面面積之比，並解釋各比例因子。
questions.solution:
(a) Linear scale factor is 3/2, so B has radius 6 cm and height 15 cm.
(b) VA=π×4²×10=160π cm³; VB=π×6²×15=540π cm³. Volume ratio is 8:27.
(c) Surface areas scale as the square of corresponding lengths, giving 4:9.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 長度比例因子為 3/2，B 半徑為 6 cm，高為 15 cm。
(b) VA=160π cm³，VB=540π cm³，體積比為 8:27。
(c) 面積比等於長度比的平方，故為 4:9。
questions.hint: Start with the relevant definition or formula.
questions.hintZh: 先寫出相關的定義或公式。
rubric: B 半徑及高分別為 6 cm、15 cm。（2 分）
體積分別為 160π、540π cm³。（2 分）
表面面積比為 4:9。（2 分）
清楚說明長度、面積及體積的比例關係。（2 分）

questions.stem: The figure shows rectangle ABCD. AB=8 cm and BC=6 cm. Find the area of triangle ABC.
questions.stemZh: 圖中 ABCD 為長方形，AB=8 cm、BC=6 cm。求三角形 ABC 的面積。
questions.solution: Area of triangle ABC = ½×AB×BC = ½×8×6 = 24 cm².
questions.solutionZh: 三角形 ABC 面積 = ½×8×6 = 24 cm²。
